analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for 5 consecutive sessions. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.84 of the 5-day average, indicating a lack of directional conviction. No clear breakout signals are present within the consolidation range between the $0.24 support and $0.26 resistance.
